Question B-006-004-001.

Why the correct answer is right: Small RG-58 has excessive loss at UHF compared with better low-loss cable choices.

Per-choice notes:
- sourceIndex 0: "Excess RF loss in the transmission line": Correct. Small RG-58 has excessive loss at UHF compared with better low-loss cable choices.
- sourceIndex 1: "Excess reflections at the antenna feed point": Small coax at high frequency mainly causes excessive attenuation; heating can result, but loss is the primary adverse consequence.
- sourceIndex 2: "Excess RF radiation from the transmission line": Small coax at high frequency mainly causes excessive attenuation; heating can result, but loss is the primary adverse consequence.
- sourceIndex 3: "Excess transmission line heating": Small coax at high frequency mainly causes excessive attenuation; heating can result, but loss is the primary adverse consequence.
